'''D3-X9''' was of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was dispatched to [[Makeb]] as part of [[Katha Niar]]'s forces, where it was stationed at the [[Drill Site Control Center]]. It assisted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hanthor]] with assembling a team to take down the [[Specialists]], a group of elite [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="TOR" />
